---
title: "shinyquota usage report"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    embed-resources: true
params:
  sessions_file: null
  clients_file: null
  app_id: "All applications"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

sessions <- readRDS(params$sessions_file)
clients <- readRDS(params$clients_file)

parse_time <- function(x) {
  as.POSIXct(sub("Z$", "", x), format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%OS", tz = "UTC")
}

if (nrow(sessions)) {
  sessions$started_at_time <- parse_time(sessions$started_at)
  sessions$day <- as.Date(sessions$started_at_time)
}
```

This is a basic operational report for **`r params$app_id`**. It summarizes the records stored by `shinyquota`; it is not an authentication or security audit.

## Summary

```{r}
#| echo: false

summary_table <- data.frame(
  Metric = c(
    "Session attempts",
    "Allowed attempts",
    "Blocked attempts",
    "Distinct IP hashes",
    "Tracked clients"
  ),
  Value = c(
    nrow(sessions),
    sum(sessions$status %in% c("allowed", "ended", "expired")),
    sum(sessions$status == "blocked"),
    length(unique(sessions$ip_hash)),
    nrow(clients)
  )
)

knitr::kable(summary_table, align = c("l", "r"))
```

## Attempts by day

```{r}
#| echo: false

if (!nrow(sessions)) {
  cat("No session records are available.")
} else {
  daily <- as.data.frame(table(sessions$day), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  names(daily) <- c("day", "attempts")
  daily$day <- as.Date(daily$day)

  plot(
    daily$day,
    daily$attempts,
    type = "h",
    lwd = 8,
    lend = 2,
    xlab = "Day",
    ylab = "Attempts"
  )
}
```

## Most active IP hashes

```{r}
#| echo: false

if (!nrow(sessions)) {
  cat("No session records are available.")
} else {
  top_ips <- sort(table(sessions$ip_hash), decreasing = TRUE)
  top_ips <- head(top_ips, 20)

  knitr::kable(
    data.frame(
      ip_hash = names(top_ips),
      attempts = as.integer(top_ips),
      row.names = NULL
    ),
    align = c("l", "r")
  )
}
```

## Recent sessions

```{r}
#| echo: false

if (!nrow(sessions)) {
  cat("No session records are available.")
} else {
  recent <- sessions[order(sessions$started_at, decreasing = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
  recent <- head(
    recent[c(
      "app_id", "ip_hash", "started_at", "ended_at",
      "status", "end_reason"
    )],
    50
  )

  knitr::kable(recent, align = c("l", "l", "l", "l", "l", "l"))
}
```
